title: Disable ligatures for monospaced fonts
summary: Prevent character combinations like 'ffi' or 'fi' from merging into single glyphs in monospaced fonts. This is useful for coding or terminal usage where distinct characters are preferred.

steps.explain: Edit ~/.config/fontconfig/fonts.conf and add a <match target="font"> block testing for the font family and appending 'liga off' and 'dlig off' to fontfeatures.

warnings: Some applications may not support the fontfeatures tag and will ignore this setting.
